answer: Cap every new identity's rewards until independent peers verify random samples of its work against signed source data. Combine accounts that reuse reviewers or artifacts so a cluster receives only one cap. Audit a vault inventory against dated ownership records, reproduce a cipher result using a public test vector, or compare a raven sighting to timestamped field images. Attackers would need distinct, credible evidence and separate review histories; minting more keys would not increase their share.
